meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把网站部署到 Vercel，并管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前先跑本地构建，部署后检查状态并验证链接可访问，再把地址发给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布网站，或要管理 Vercel 项目、域名等时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 用 --prod --yes 部署并验证链接

say.text: 给当前项目添加域名 example.com
把 Vercel 的环境变量拉取到本地 .env

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys web apps to Vercel with the vercel CLI and manages projects, domains and env vars. It runs a local build first, checks deployment status, verifies the URL responds, then sends you the link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs vercel deploy --prod --yes, then verifies the URL

say_en.text: Add the domain example.com to this project
Pull Vercel environment variables into local .env
